unowned.note: Deliberately chargeable to no system: prose, audit records, and the repo-wide manifests that change for every system's reasons and none of their own. Everything else must be owned, and audit-status fails when a tracked file is neither.

systems.name: DSL load path
systems.note: Two independent audits of chunks 1-8 (dsl-modules-2026-07-29-full.md and dsl-modules-2026-07-29-codex-independent.md), reconciled in the doc above — read that one; it carries the agreement ranking and the reproductions. Each pass found a HIGH the other missed, so neither source doc is sufficient alone. The full-system pass deliberately crossed into src/runtime/save.ts and scripts/, because engine requirement 6 is implemented outside this system's paths; that does not certify the Runtime system, whose own counter is untouched. Now also owns content/, the shipped DSL this path exists to load; the contribution system's files under src/content are owned by both, which is double coverage rather than a gap.

systems.name: Runtime
systems.note: Pass-1 L4 and L6 open, both BLOCKED on the action.health/target: unification; pass-2 L1 and pass-1 L2 closed 2026-07-29. Counter restarts at the restructure; pre-move commits are not attributable per layer.

systems.name: Contribution system
systems.note: Was recorded as unbuilt with no paths while its code demonstrably existed, so its commits were charged to Testing Procedure's broad scripts coverage. Given real paths 2026-07-29, then baselined by two independent audits (contribution-system-2026-07-29.md and -independent.md) reconciled in the doc above — read that one; it carries the agreement ranking and the reproductions. Neither source doc is sufficient alone: the first pass certified the issue-body extraction as closed and the second reproduced a HIGH in it, while the second missed the raw-regex namespace rewrite the first found. The seven decisions the reconciliation surfaced are settled in backlog.md under a three-tier label model (mod-pending / mod-approved / mod-auto-enabled), which supersedes the flat approved-mod label the audits were written against; R1 and R4 are fixed against it and the manifest is now v2. The editor and the validation/merge engine are still unbuilt.

systems.name: User interface
systems.note: src/ui does not exist; the 2026-07-28 audit covers teardown residue only, and its coverage is structurally limited until the GUI rebuild.

systems.name: Testing procedure
systems.note: Now owns .claude/hooks, which gate commits and were owned by nobody (M5). Its scripts coverage is narrowed to the files it actually implements, with the contribution scripts charged to their own system; the orphan check below is what makes that narrowing safe. runTest and # test parsing still live under src/ and are covered by the DSL load path and Runtime as well.
